name: Soft Silicone Bath Brush with Hooks | Baby & Adult Body Scrubber | Random Color | With Box
description:
Enjoy a soothing, hygienic, and refreshing bath experience with the Soft Silicone Bath Brush with Hooks (Random Color) — a gentle yet effective body scrubber designed for babies, kids, and adults alike. Made from 100% food-grade silicone, this brush features ultra-soft bristles that create a rich, bubbly lather for a deep but gentle clean from head to toe.Unlike traditional loofahs, it’s bacteria-resistant, easy to clean, and long-lasting, making it perfect for sensitive skin. Its ergonomic design includes a built-in loop for easy grip and hanging, ensuring convenience and quick drying after use.Key Features:
 Made from 100% food-grade silicone – safe & durable
 Ultra-soft bristles for gentle, deep cleansing
 Built-in soap tank (up to 60ml) for easy use
 Hygienic & bacteria-resistant design
 Ideal for all skin types, including sensitive skin
 Multi-purpose use – bath, massage, exfoliation, or pet care
 Comes with hanging hook for quick drying & easy storage
 Random color deliveryHow to Use:
 Fill the top tank with your favorite body wash.
 Gently press the top to release soap while scrubbing.
 Use in circular motions for cleansing and massage.
 Rinse and hang using the built-in hook after each use.
